section13_checks.prohibition_description: Grant Agreement Annex template used as the governing structural schema.
Invented call constraints, scope requirements, expected outcomes, or expected impacts not in Tier 2B.
Invented project facts, including budget figures, not present in or traceable to Tier 3.
section13_checks.violation_evidence: The assessment passes the budget gate on a budget whose source is self-labelled fictional: "budget_response_reference": "budget_response_FICTIONAL_demo_2026-10-01.json", with every budget_line_reference pointing to "received/budget_response_FICTIONAL_demo_2026-10-01.json#..." (e.g. WP1, P01). The artifact carries no traceability_footer linking the partner IDs (P01-P12), work-package IDs (WP1-WP7), or the budget figures to any path within docs/tier3_project_instantiation/. Budget figures are an enumerated project fact under §13.3 and a fictional budget source is not a Tier 3 source.

section13_checks.prohibition_description: Commencing Phase 8 activity before the budget gate has passed.
Storing durable decisions only in agent memory without writing them to Tier 4.
A workflow or skill becoming a de facto constitutional authority.
Silently reordering phases or weakening gate conditions.
Finalising proposal text with incomplete or unvalidated source state without flagging the gap.
Generic programme knowledge used as a substitute for Tier 1 source documents.
Tier 5 outputs not traceable to specific Tier 1-4 inputs.
Modifying Tier 1 or Tier 2 source documents to reflect project assumptions.
Treating CLAUDE.md as advisory or optional.

decision_log_entry.resolution_note: Constitutional violation detected; requires human operator resolution. The Phase 7 gate declares "pass" on a budget whose source file is self-labelled fictional (budget_response_FICTIONAL_demo_2026-10-01.json); under §13.3 budget figures are an enumerated project fact and must be traceable to Tier 3, and under §8.3/§17.6.7 budget figures may not be fabricated. This skill flags the violation; it does not resolve it.
